correctness.rationale: Decomposition of each coordinate into constant, activity contrast and q-2 zero-at-zero transverse character modes yields the exact block spectrum. Conditioning on Bin(n-1,p) and Bin(n-2,p) gives m,d,e,c and transverse beta; radial contrast mu=d-e and the remaining 2x2 eigenvalues lambda±. The characteristic polynomial signs F(beta)=-(n-1)(q-1)alpha*s/q² and F(mu)=-n(q-1)r*s/q² prove strict interlacing. B_1 separates all first-band functions, and the complement to B_k for k<=n-2 also does, giving 0<lambda- and lambda+<1. Local/central binomial limits produce q-independent Gaussian outliers. Independent exact binomial identities checked 390 tuples and direct complex Fourier matrices checked 3 cases.
residual_risks: Strict lambda+<1 excludes k=n-1; n,q,k boundary regimes treated separately.

But summing eigenvalues of shell matrices does not produce ball eigenvalues because their two-dimensional radial blocks generally fail to share eigenvectors. No inspected earlier theorem states the nonbinary full-ball four-sector ordering and q-independent Gaussian outliers.
